module: Editing toolbox for the driveline spline (rally driving line) for the rally editor. All functions take a "host" (the window that owns host.drivelineV3, host.selectedNodeIdx, host.dragState, host.path) and an optional opts table of callbacks (onBeforeMutation, onSplineMutated, onCommit, onHistoryRestore, inputBlocked/isInputBlocked, generateFinal). handleSplineInteraction handles the mouse: hover/move a node (click-drag), insert a node on the curve, add a node at the start or end (the nearest), delete the selected node with the Delete key (if more than 2 nodes). Each change is recorded in editor.history with a deep before/after copy of the spline (nodes, widths, nmls).
notes: A moved node is snapped back to the surface via zSnap.snapDrivelineInPlace (options useRaycast and vertRayRaise from the driveline properties).
The tolerance for selecting a node with the mouse ray is 0.5 + 0.15 × sqrt(camera distance) meters.
A newly inserted node receives the width drivelineUtil.defaultSplineWidth and the average normal of the two neighboring nodes; a node added at an end takes the width and normal of the end node.
saveFinalDriveline fails (E log, returns false) if there are fewer than 2 nodes, no host.path or no mission folder.

restoreSpline.desc: Replaces the host spline's content (nodes, widths, nmls) with a saved copy, marks it dirty then recomputes the geometry and the final driveline.

commitSplineEdit.desc: Records in editor.history an action with the old spline and a copy of the current one; undo and redo call onHistoryRestore(host, actionName, 'undo'|'redo') if provided. Then calls opts.onCommit.

oldSpline.desc: Copy of the spline before modification.

refreshSplineGeometry.desc: If the spline is dirty and has at least 2 nodes, recomputes its geometry, regenerates the final driveline (unless opts.generateFinal == false) and calls onSplineMutated.

returns.desc: true if the geometry was updated.

simplifySpline.desc: Simplifies the spline (Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm on nodes, widths and normals) with a tolerance, updates the geometry and records the "Simplify Spline" action. No effect with 2 nodes or fewer.

returns.desc: true if the spline was simplified.

createFinalDriveline.desc: Generates the final driveline from the spline (drivelineV3:createDrivelineFromSpline).

returns.desc: Generation result; false if host.drivelineV3 is missing.

saveFinalDriveline.desc: Saves the spline to a file in the notebook's mission folder (drivelineV3:saveSplineToFile) after checking the prerequisites.

host.desc: Object carrying drivelineV3 and path (with getMissionDir()).

handleSplineInteraction.desc: Call every frame: handles the mouse on the spline (hover, node drag, insertion, addition, deletion with Delete). Does nothing if ImGui captures the mouse, if input is blocked or if the mouse is not over the map.

host.desc: Object carrying drivelineV3 (spline.nodes/widths/nmls, updateSplineGeometry...), selectedNodeIdx, dragState, deletePressed.

opts.desc: Callbacks: onBeforeMutation, onSplineMutated, onCommit, onHistoryRestore, inputBlocked, isInputBlocked, generateFinal.
